_comment: Secrets-sweep watchlist: public repos of live protocols, swept tree+history by secrets_sweep.py for committed keys/creds (the Taiko/Raiko enclave-key.pem class - in plain sight in public git ~2y before noticed). Seeded with upstreams of our fork-families (a leak upstream = batch-relevant across forks we indexed). Grow it: `python toolkit/secrets_sweep.py --add <org/repo> <protocol> <chain>` as we triage open-source targets. Reference case (fixed, not actively swept - too large): taikoxyz/taiko-mono. Clones land in hunts/_volume/_secrets/ (gitignored); seen-state in monitor/secrets-seen.json.
